sharedRules.name: BOOM!
sharedRules.description: This model may destroy itself as a short action during its activation. When this model is destroyed they explode. The explosion causes D6+1 AP1 hits to each unit (friend or foe within D6" (roll separately for each unit hit to determine the number of hits it sustains). Every unit hit also gains one suppression token (regardless of how many casualties are caused).

sharedRules.name: Tactical Genius Order
sharedRules.description:
This Order may only be issued by a Marauder Commando Captain. As a Level 2 Command, the Captain is able to take advantage of every mistake made by the opposing force. This Order may be given any time the opponent rolls one or more blanks on their Command dice. If successful, the Commando Captain may take the blank dice rolled by the opponent and use them to immediately issue another Order of his choice. Any units activated by this Order must do so before the opponent carries out their own Order and continues with their Turn. Once rolled these dice are returned to the used pool of the opposing player, any + symbols rolled on when issuing the Commando Captain's order are ignored.
If the Commando Captain’s Order prevents the opponent from carrying out their own Order (by killing the original target for example), the opponent’s Order is wasted.
